title: Model Binding & Validation in ASP.NET Core

scenes.line1: How does ASP.NET Core handle data?
scenes.say: How does ASP.NET Core turn HTTP data into safe, usable objects? And what stops bad input from slipping through?

scenes.label: Binding
scenes.sub: Maps request data to your action parameters.
scenes.say: First, model binding grabs data from the request and maps it to your action parameters or models.

scenes.label: Validation
scenes.sub: Checks data using annotations or custom logic.
scenes.say: Next, validation checks if that data is correct, using data annotations or custom logic.
Here's a quick example. The Required attribute ensures the Name property can't be empty when the controller receives data.

scenes.question: What if you skip ModelState check?
scenes.right: Invalid data could reach your business logic and cause bugs.
scenes.say: Interview trap: What happens if you forget to check ModelState? Invalid data could reach your business logic and cause bugs.
